persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Wanda, 64, who leads the youth group at her church. She is planning a youth soccer tournament and also collecting the mission trip fees. Everything is in her head, and today she cannot remember what she was supposed to do next, or who she is waiting for.

challenge.intro: Now you are Wanda. The board will be empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Next Step Board with the normal app link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome card shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK, and the board is empty. If it does not show: scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK (if it says there is nothing to erase, just tap OK). The example cards come back after the reload, so scroll down to the buttons at the bottom and tap 'Start blank' → OK. The board now says 'No projects yet'.

tasks.text: Give the board the name Youth Group.
tasks.hint: The board's name is the big title at the very top. Tap it.

tasks.text: Add a project for the youth soccer tournament. Its next step is to book the school field.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nextstep_board_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.projects)return false;var ps=d.projects;var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var f=ps.filter(function(p){var n=low(p.name);return n.indexOf('football')>=0||n.indexOf('tournament')>=0});return f.some(function(p){return low(p.next).indexOf('field')>=0})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Use '+ Add project' at the bottom of the board. Put the next step in the box called 'The next step'. If the card already exists, use '✏️ Next' on it.

tasks.text: The tournament also needs three jobs: buy a ball, call six teams, find a referee. Put them on the tournament's list, and show that you have already bought the ball.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nextstep_board_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.projects)return false;var ps=d.projects;var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var f=ps.filter(function(p){var n=low(p.name);return n.indexOf('football')>=0||n.indexOf('tournament')>=0});return f.some(function(p){var t=p.tasks||[];var has=function(w){return t.filter(function(x){return low(x[0]).indexOf(w)>=0})};var b=has('ball'),tm=has('team'),r=has('referee');return b.length&&tm.length&&r.length&&b.some(function(x){return !!x[2]})&&!tm.some(function(x){return !!x[2]})&&!r.some(function(x){return !!x[2]})})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Open the Checklist at the bottom of the tournament card. Add each job with the 'add an item…' box, then tick only the job that is already done.

tasks.text: Add a project called Mission trip fees. You have already asked Pastor Dave for help from the church fund, and now you are waiting for his answer. Make the card show that.
tasks.hint: After you add the fees project, look at the small label on its card. The 'Status ▸' button changes it. Which word means you are waiting for someone else?

tasks.text: The school field must be booked by 31 October 2026. Give the tournament that due date.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nextstep_board_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.projects)return false;var ps=d.projects;var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var f=ps.filter(function(p){var n=low(p.name);return n.indexOf('football')>=0||n.indexOf('tournament')>=0});return f.some(function(p){return p.due==='2026-10-31'})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Tap '+ due date' on the tournament card. Type it as month/day/year: 10/31/2026.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: shows every project on one screen
each project has one small next step and who does it
shows which projects are waiting on someone else, so nothing is forgotten

lines: Welcome. This short video explains Next Step Board. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. Most of us carry many projects at once. A church event, the taxes, a repair at home.
Projects rarely stall because they are hard. They stall because the next move is fuzzy, or because you forgot you were waiting on someone.
Next Step Board fixes that with one idea. For every project, write down one thing: the next small step, and whose turn it is.
It is for anyone juggling more than a few things: a busy family, a church volunteer, a small business owner.
Let us look at the screen. At the very top is the name of the board. Tap the name to rename it, for example Church projects, or Home.
Under the name is a row of buttons: All, Active, Waiting, Blocked, Paused, and Needs me. They choose which cards you see.
Needs me shows only the cards where it is your turn.
Below that is a box called Where you left off. It counts what is waiting and suggests which project to start with.
Under the box are the cards. Each card is one project: an emoji, a name, one line about it, and a small status label on the right.
The most important part of a card is the Next step. One small thing to do, and under it, who does it and how long it takes.
Beside the priority, P3, are two small arrows. Tap up to raise it, down to lower it. Higher priority cards sort to the top.
Tap plus due date and type a date, month first. It turns orange when the date is close, and red when it is overdue.
When a step is due within a week, a Coming up bar appears at the top, with an add to calendar link.
Now the buttons on each card. The pencil button, Next, changes the next step. It asks what the step is, then who and how long.
Status, with the little arrow, moves the card along. Active, then Waiting, then Blocked, then Paused, and back to Active.
Waiting means the ball is in someone else's court. Blocked means something is in the way. Paused means later, and the card fades so it stops nagging.
Today, with the check mark, says you worked on it today. Card changes the name and emoji. The red X deletes the card, and asks you first.
At the bottom of each card is the Checklist. Type a small job in the box that says add an item, and tap Add. Tick it when it is done.
To add your own project, scroll down and tap plus Add project. A form slides up for the name, the next step, and who does it. Then tap Add it.
Rather talk it through? Let your AI build my board gives you a prompt to copy into Claude or ChatGPT. Paste the answer back, and it builds the cards.
Here is how to start. The board opens with a few Example cards, so you can see how it reads.
Add one real project and write its next step. Delete the examples with the red X when you are ready.
Then the habit. Every morning, read down the board and do the next steps that are yours.
Your board saves on this phone by itself. No account, nothing to sign up for, and it works without internet. Tap Backup once a week to keep a copy.
Next Step Board comes with the Business membership.
And the question mark button in the corner has the tour and help any time you need them.

daily.task: Move one card to its next column in Next Step Board — or add one new card.

explore.name: 🏷 Board name · filters
explore.find: Open Next Step Board. The top.
explore.try: Rename the board. Tap All, Active, Waiting, Blocked and Needs me.

explore.name: 🗂 A project card
explore.try: Tap ▲ and ▼. Tap + due date: try 10/15/2026, then 13/45/2026 and letters. Tap ✓ Today. Tap Status ▸ all the way round.

explore.name: ✏️ Change a card
explore.try: Tap ✏️ Next and ✏️ Card and change them. Tap ✕ — it asks first.

explore.name: ☑️ Checklist
explore.try: Add three items (one empty). Tick them all — does the card go green?

explore.name: ➕ Add project
explore.find: Tap + Add project at the bottom.
explore.try: Answer every question. Try a very long name and emoji.

explore.name: 🔔 Notifications
explore.try: Allow or block — both are fine. Note what it says.

explore.name: 🤖 Let your AI build my board
explore.find: Tap 🤖 Let your AI build my board.
explore.try: Tap 📋 Copy the prompt. Paste some nonsense in the box and Build my board — what does it say?

explore.name: 💾 Backup · Restore · Reset
explore.try: Tap Backup (you can cancel). Look at Restore. Try Reset to examples — it asks first.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), ✨ Ask an AI, 🌉 More from Daraja, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
